title: Director, Sales (Nordics & Eastern Europe)
description:

At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

This leader will be a model to drive the team in building extraordinary customer relationships and experiences, leveraging a strong teamwork approach, and cross matrix collaboration across all Ping functions. description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Pourquoi Deliveroo ?

Lorsque l'on vous dit Deliveroo, vous imaginez sans doute d'abord les bons petits plats livrés chez vous en moins d'une demi-heure. Plutôt sympa non ? Mais c'est en coulisses que l'histoire est la plus intéressante. Nous opérons désormais à travers le monde et travaillons avec plus de 176 000 restaurants partenaires et commerces en tous genres en France. Nous collaborons avec des milliers de livreurs et de livreuses partenaires pour le plus grand bonheur de nos millions de personnes clientes.

Nous recherchons un·e Assistant·e Chef de Projet Marketing Merchant en alternance pour rejoindre notre équipe Marketing à Paris, pour une durée de 12 mois. Aux côtés de l'équipe Merchant, vous contribuerez au développement de la croissance de nos partenaires, au déploiement de nos campagnes nationales 360° et en accompagnerez des projets à fort impact sur l'acquisition, la rétention et la fidélisation de nos restaurants partenaires.

title: Staff Product Manager, Generative AI Platform
description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat. DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt now operate as one global company. Behind the AI experiences millions of people use every day, from shopping assistants to customer support agents, sits one shared Generative AI platform. Our team builds it.

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager in London to own major parts of that platform. Your customers are the engineers and ML researchers across all three brands who build AI products and agents. You'll work with engineering and product leaders in Europe and the US, and your decisions will shape how AI gets built across every market we operate in.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Set the strategy and roadmap for core parts of our GenAI platform: model access and routing, agent infrastructure, and evaluation and observability.
  • Build one platform for three brands. Spot the patterns across Deliveroo, Wolt and DoorDash teams and turn them into shared building blocks, so a capability built once reaches every market.
  • Shape our model portfolio across frontier and open-weight models. Decide where we build, buy or partner in an ecosystem that changes month to month.
  • Make agents production-ready. Give teams safe access to company knowledge, tools and systems, with the quality, latency and cost controls needed to run agents at scale.
  • Own the evaluation strategy so teams can prove quality before launch and keep improving it after.
  • Stay close to your customers.

title: Senior Consultant / Manager – Power Market Advisory
description:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Markets & Transactions team is looking for a Senior Consultant / Manager to join the team in Amsterdam.
